pr.title: R000B: reject invalid radar epochs and preserve recovery sky
pr.body:
Radar acquisition could dispatch an Image for finite seconds that overflowed or produced an invalid Date epoch. Validate both frame and index epochs in the authored `fetchRadar` before dispatch and installation. During the required native recovery test, sky withdrawal also exposed a stale preview flag and an intermediate fallback flash. Complete the existing currentness-checked preview presentation in the same turn, preserving current preview-owned lunar detail.

Implements #11 (R000B). This Draft PR preserves the accepted weather/radar authority policy and the delivered R000C work. It does not authorize merge or close the issue.

## Exact candidate

- Head: `573dc2b15af37b5d32faa4364f3e653b65431dfc`
- Git tree: `3656edba44b79ab7216c8cbf3546f4fe085bee9a`
- Reviewed base: `16658749209e0c567f49a3fc9dc855f665afa6e4`
- Immutable specification: `21e7a84365fae37a86cae5c7d5e41008c0adc53f`
- Runtime: `c2753a21c337ff0bc09cea05f15bfc7729dcc2295a924c11284399fdab6e9ea2` (135 files)
- Separate immutable evidence commit: `885348adc26f9db468b39b65ba2c07cf130d26ca` (not a deployment or merge branch)
- [Evidence manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/885348adc26f9db468b39b65ba2c07cf130d26ca/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000B/manifest.json) SHA-256: `54d4272917e4e68fe42bc2e07ee2b3dee49552cbba6e559413e9d7ff6d593bc5`
- [Reviewed candidate certificate](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/885348adc26f9db468b39b65ba2c07cf130d26ca/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000B/reviewed-candidate-certificate.json)

| Authored/generated consumer | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/native/index.html` | `37fb7477e23d02329eacbf8ff94107fb3ea40a7d62020ef56a245af56e0ade00` |
| `index.html` | `d4e3f084aea7d264a5c790268a21aa015b5e565e1feb9ad853d953c1c8a7b26f` |
| `offline.html` | `dbda7e967be39d85ca6b970c06b4053d60335b6b50d59f7849512e1a22ccec6e` |
| `real-sky/native-host.mjs` | `a5586f87ee14c0c1d24f5f933aefc1fad724454636fd4dd4a2ea9ded80642e0c` |
| `real-sky/native-sky.js` | `7e47b46652fdb2a22b9ea4c1e15777ac636f789434fb53a0ea5492eeb3fa7568` |

Runtime impact is limited to the radar epoch guard and refined-to-preview sky withdrawal. The existing builder regenerated `index.html`, `real-sky/native-sky.js` and `offline.html`. README, DESIGN and HANDOFF now document source/receipt semantics and diagnostics. Tests, the bounded R000B fixture/drivers and a compact evidence index complete this PR. The complete lossless packet lives at the immutable evidence commit above; keeping its 1.31 GB outside main preserves all artifacts without adding them to Pages. No provider, configuration, freshness limit, model-estimate policy, lunar geometry, dependency or frozen V1 change.

## Validation and independent review

- B04/B13: 57 actual-source controls pass; baseline has four genuine before-dispatch assertion failures and 53 passes. Image dispatch, installation and authority remain separate observables.
- B14: all four isolated source mutants fail their intended original assertions; corresponding unmodified and positive controls pass. Exact spans, hashes and raw assertions are retained; mutant HTML is excluded.
- Sky handoff: 53 targeted source tests pass, independently repeated. The intermediate recovery flash and paired semantic RED controls are retained.
- Affected inherited suites: 245 passes, zero failures, four unchanged TODOs. Frozen V1 and generated-source checks pass.
- Six final native cases: Chromium and Firefox, default/reduced/full override, advancing 1x September 7 fixture, inclusive source expiry, controlled 503 and ordinary healthy retry. Exact unchanged radar retry controls are narrowly reused.
- [Independent joined review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/885348adc26f9db468b39b65ba2c07cf130d26ca/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000B/independent-review/final-joined-review.json), SHA-256 `6d4ac1a177bf71c617bef15ff2381e4bce8ae7d11cc8c1d748c67e460d93b559`. Individual case reports, source/currentness review and raw evidence are linked from the [packet](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/885348adc26f9db468b39b65ba2c07cf130d26ca/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000B/README.md).

Independent prepublication custody review also passed for the exact source/evidence commits: all 619 stored files and 8,810 retained originals were verified. It found and resolved one B17 reference error before publication: the evidence branch now carries exact qualified README/DESIGN/HANDOFF copies. No source or native evidence changed in that repair. Report SHA-256: `8920157cc9d8a672a0f87f9b6b276c01b9b856d9bee3c07e5f25a129355fc9d9`. Public-head/artifact readback remains a separate pending check.

## Original B01–B18 matrix

The original accepted assessment and every original row are retained in the [machine-readable matrix](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/885348adc26f9db468b39b65ba2c07cf130d26ca/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000B/acceptance-matrix.json). B18's delivery and closure effects remain pending.

| Row | Candidate disposition | Original obligation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B01 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Retain current valid time, aggregation interval and retrieval time separately; do not invent source time. |
| B02 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Retain radar mosaic frame generation, index generation and retrieval separately. |
| B03 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Finite current metadata and positive interval use explicit captured-zone, calendar-valid and unambiguous conversion. |
| B04 | SOURCE_ACCEPTED | Radar frame seconds must be finite and valid before epoch multiplication; absent frame time cannot borrow index time. |
| B05 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Use named 15-minute current authority bound on both source and receipt, inclusive; future allowance zero. |
| B06 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Use named 20-minute radar source/frame and retrieval bounds, inclusive; six-hour cache retention never current authority. |
| B07 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Evaluate expiry at every real-time consumer; apply one selected snapshot to code, chip, cloud layers, precipitation, temperature, humidity, wind and native sky. |
| B08 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Unavailable real-time presentation clears icon/temperature/effects without claiming measured clear; prayer stale row remains independent. |
| B09 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Legacy {w,ts} remains readable and storage bytes preserved; missing source metadata is nonauthoritative, not destructive migration. |
| B10 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Cache current hit must not suppress missing hourly-track acquisition; accepted-current bookkeeping separate from attempts/rejected old source. |
| B11 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Preserve current clear versus hourly thunder, explicit SIM/ADVANCING forecast lanes; live radar excluded from SIM. |
| B12 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Combined temporal/ownership control captures New York zone before global Riyadh change; current-generation success07:30Z; obsolete attempt must not commit. |
| B13 | SOURCE_ACCEPTED | Four-hour old model/radar/repeated-frame, missing/NaN time, future+1ms/+24h cache, invalid interval and healthy wet restoration require final-tree discriminators. |
| B14 | SOURCE_ACCEPTED | Independent source→receipt, consumer-expiry bypass and global-zone mutants must make corresponding witnesses fail. |
| B15 | ACCEPTED_PRESERVED | Disposable-browser fresh→expired→outage→fresh sequence must show chip/data-fx and no wet effects after expiry, with crops. |
| B16 | SCOPED_NATIVE_ACCEPTED | Preserve 325×530 card/header/footer, moon opacity and cloud continuity in the affected transitions. |
| B17 | DOCS_ACCEPTED | Update DESIGN, README and diagnostics to distinguish model-valid time, interval, retrieval, mosaic generation and unavailable; no ground-observation/universal-coverage/offline guarantee. |
| B18 | LOCAL_JOINED_REVIEW_ACCEPTED__PUBLIC_HEAD_DELIVERY_AND_CLOSURE_PENDING | Joined temporal/cache/consumer review and evidence comment precede manual closure; public repair requires matching served-source/consumer readback. |

## Retained failures and limits

Original first-state Moon omissions remain documented terrain cold-acquisition limitations; no later healthy frame supplies a first-state complete-Moon PASS. All original Firefox blank/incomplete video frames remain failures. The final Firefox PNG route independently covers five states, six-second ordinary recovery and thirty-second native motion, with per-capture clock and byte bindings. It does not replace unsupported video frames or prove pixels between captures. Chromium's recovered intervals and the demonstrated reduced-motion recovery counterexample have separately scoped original-frame review.

The old warm missing-Moon frames and intermediate Chromium blue flash/black lunar limb remain failed evidence. The bounded diagnostic did not establish a unique cause for each historical frame. These controlled provider fixtures do not certify live ground observations, universal radar coverage, all-phase Moon science or offline-app operation. See [contrary evidence](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/885348adc26f9db468b39b65ba2c07cf130d26ca/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R000B/contrary-evidence.json) and the case-specific limitations.

## Reserved effects

After independent public PR-head/tree/artifact readback, request one owner decision on this exact head and reviewed base. Merge is not authorized by this PR. Following that approval, the same assignment must verify main/Pages/source/docs/public consumer delivery, publish and independently read back `CLOSE-R000B` on #11, then close completed and independently verify the closed state. The PR deliberately does not auto-close #11.
